code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob, helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper}, framework/schedulers/NotificationJobsScheduler, resources/{cron-schedules-prod.properties, application-prod.properties}. Other repos: not used. The old copy ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice/ is ignored (stale)
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); demo_remark: Vault Code Split, Vault must run because the notice needs vehicle and owner info, Vault permission granted to the App Service (cannot verify from repo). There is no flow deck. This is the hirer version of OCMS12.8: the contact checks before the electronic reminder are done by NotificationSmsEmailJob, one query for all reminder stages (RD1-DR3), so a notice whose hirer 2nd letter was just processed (last stage DN2) is included. Because every step runs inside the eNotification job that is switched off (cron.notification.enabled=false in prod), every step is Sebagian. Other gaps: (1) the contact refresh from DataHive/DOS is off (cron.enareminder.datahive=false); (2) for a company hirer at stage DN2 the email content is deliberately skipped ('no template available'), so the email step is Beda dari flow; (3) loadAllExcludedIds returns an empty set when the read fails (fail-open), but the reminder query carries its own NOT IN exclusion list so an opt-out is still filtered in the query; refreshContactInfo runs for all records before the exclusion gate; (4) the DN2_* template text lives in the DB, cannot verify from repo. DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. Ticket: OCMS-DF-2026-180 (Closed; remark waits for the eNotification cron to be activated; reminder stages RD1-DR3 unchanged).
recommendation: Claim partially. The contact-check code exists, but the eNotification job is off in prod, the DataHive refresh is off, and the company email at stage DN2 is deliberately skipped. Ask URA when the eNotification cron and the DataHive refresh are switched on and whether a company-hirer email at DN2 is really not wanted

steps.step: After the hirer 2nd letter is processed (last stage DN2), OCMS selects the notices that fall in the electronic reminder window
steps.detail: queryRecordsForReminder selects notices with last_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3) (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1114), so a hirer notice whose 2nd letter was just processed (last stage DN2) is included. Other conditions: due date (last_processing_date + POS + PDD) <= today + ENOTEDAYS, offender_indicator = 'Y' (:1112), no suspension (or TS-HST) and no earlier SMS/email record for the same stage (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1076-1121); called from NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:162. Sebagian because the whole job runs through a scheduler that is skipped when cron.notification.enabled=false in cron-schedules-prod.properties:236 (the scheduler skips execution, NotificationJobsScheduler.java:30-31 and 49-52), same value in dev and UAT; the real server value cannot be verified from repo. The ENOTEDAYS/POS/PDD parameters live in the DB: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: A hirer who opted out of electronic reminders (exclusion list) or holds a passport is not sent a reminder
steps.detail: The reminder query drops onod.id_no values that are in ocms_enotification_exclusion_list (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1131-1134). The job checks again with the preloaded list and skips those IDs (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:194, 226-232); passport holders are skipped at every stage (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:237-243). loadAllExcludedIds returns an empty set when the read fails / fail-open (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1207-1216), but the check inside the query still applies. The reminder stage is not moved back. Sebagian because it only runs when the eNotification job is active (cron.notification.enabled=false in cron-schedules-prod.properties:236 (the scheduler skips execution, NotificationJobsScheduler.java:30-31 and 49-52)). The content of the exclusion list and how an ID gets on it: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS checks the latest mobile number (individual) or email (company) of the hirer with DOS (DataHive) before the reminder, per Epic OCMS9
steps.detail: The job calls batchPreloadContactInfo and then refreshContactInfo per record (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:185-188). Individuals are checked against DataHive Singpass (refreshIndividualContactInfo, NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2710) and companies against DataHive CorpPass by UEN (refreshCompanyContactInfo, :2496). But every refresh only runs when cron.enareminder.datahive = 'true' (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:92-93, 2325-2340, 2461-2485) and the value is false in cron-schedules-prod.properties:48 (also dev and UAT). With that value the code uses the contact stored in owner_driver. refreshContactInfo runs for all records before the exclusion gate. DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo; the content of the DataHive view cannot be verified from repo.

steps.step: A hirer without a valid mobile number (individual) or email (company) is skipped
steps.detail: validateContactInfo rejects records with a contactError; a company (id_type B) must have an email, an individual must have a phoneNo (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2259-2290). A failing record is skipped with a log and does not enter the batch; a non-ENA stage is not changed (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:254-266). The logic matches the story but runs only in the eNotification job that is off in prod (cron.notification.enabled=false in cron-schedules-prod.properties:236 (the scheduler skips execution, NotificationJobsScheduler.java:30-31 and 49-52)), hence Sebagian. Completeness of contact data in the DB: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: An individual hirer with valid contact is passed to the SMS batch that refers to the 2nd letter
steps.detail: An individual that passes is added to smsRecords (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:275-292) and the template is chosen from stage + channel + recipient type (determineTemplateName, NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:301 and 456-476), so for last stage DN2 DN2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL or DN2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL_COMBINED is used. The actual sending is the scope of OCMS12.28. Sebagian because cron.notification.enabled=false in cron-schedules-prod.properties:236 (the scheduler skips execution, NotificationJobsScheduler.java:30-31 and 49-52) and in prod sms.enable=false with no sms.allowedSources (application-prod.properties:87). The template text (whether it refers to the 2nd letter) lives in the DB: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: A company hirer with a valid email is passed to the email reminder that refers to the 2nd letter
steps.detail: determineDeliveryChannel returns EMAIL for id_type B (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:443-452), but generateMessages deliberately skips building the email content for stages DN1, DN2 and DR3 with the comment 'no template available' (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:311-318). The job then logs 'Skipping email ... template not found, no content generated' and does not send (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:378-384). So a company hirer at last stage DN2 never receives the reminder email, which differs from the story. The email sending scope is OCMS12.29.
